explanation: Keep at most k−1 candidate words using Misra–Gries cancellation: when k candidates accumulate, decrement all and erase zero counts. Rescan the stream to verify surviving candidates and return only frequencies strictly above n/k.
timeComplexity: O(S+n) expected amortized time including hashing for n words and S characters.
spaceComplexity: O(kL) stored candidate-key space for maximum word length L.
